figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
FIG. 1. GC-MS analysis of the product of the recombinant pro-
tein. Selected ion mass fragmentation patterns are illustrated for au-
thentic (6)-taxa-4(5),11(12)-diene (Rt 5 12.72 min) and for the diter-
pene (Rt 5 12.73 min) obtained from geranylgeranyl diphosphate when
incubated with a cell-free extract of E. coli harboring pTb42.1. The
origin of the selected diagnostic ions, which account for most of the full
spectrum abundance, is described under “Materials and Methods” and
elsewhere (8, 11).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
FIG. 2. Nucleotide and predicted amino acid sequence of Pa-
cific yew taxadiene synthase clone pTb42.1. The start and stop
codons are underlined, the locations of regions employed for primer
synthesis are double underlined, and the DDMAD and DSYDD motifs
are in boldface.
